name: apple-maps/search
description: Search places on Apple Maps by keyword and location, with name, category, rating, address, phone, hours and coordinates.

sort.description: Parameter defines the sorting refinement for the search. Can be one of the following: `distance` - Sort by distance from the `center`/`location`. `ratings` - Sort by result ratings. `default` - Sort by best match for your query. This is the default.

span.description: Parameter defines width and height of the search region as `latitudeDelta,longitudeDelta`. Smaller delta values correspond to a higher zoom level. (defaults to `0.5,0.5`).

query.description: Parameter defines the query you want to search. You can use anything that you would use in a regular Apple Maps search.

center.description: Parameter defines coordinates of the center point of the region you want to search within. You can pass the coordinates as `latitude,longitude`. (e.g. `30.324639,-97.7304611` for Austin, TX). Either a `center` or a `location` parameter is required. These parameters can't be used together.

locale.description: Parameter defines the locale the results should be localized for. Locales for Apple Maps are represented as `<LANGUAGE>-<REGION>`. (defaults to `en-US`, the locale for U.S. English). Head to Apple Maps Locales for the list of available locales.

open_at.description: Parameter defines the time at which result locations should be open at. The value must be a Unix timestamp that is in the future, and no more than 24 hours from the current time. (e.g. `1794559756`).

toggles.description: Parameter defines the toggle options for the search. A comma separated list of toggle `key` values can be passed to this parameter. See the `refinements.toggles` object of the response to see available toggles for a search.

location.description: Parameter defines the GPS coordinates used for the search origin. (e.g. `Austin, Texas, United States`). Either a `center` or a `location` parameter is required. These parameters can't be used together.

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

multi_select_options.description: Parameter defines the options you want to filter by for multi select refinements. A comma separated list of toggle `key` values can be passed to this parameter. See the `refinement.multi_select.<type>.options` object of the response to see available multi select refinements for the search.

# Apple Maps Search

Search places on Apple Maps by keyword and location, with name, category, rating, address, phone, hours and coordinates.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/apple-maps/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "coffee", "location": "Austin, TX"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.
